children: RNS Number : 4473V  iShares III PLC  18 September 2026
iShares € High Yield Corp Bond ESG Paris-Aligned Climate UCITS ETF (ISIN: IE000H92C4B8) and iShares $ High Yield Corp Bond ESG Paris-Aligned Climate UCITS ETF (ISIN: IE000W1AURU9) (the "Funds")

The Company announces that, at the Extraordinary General Meeting of the Company held at Apex IFS Limited, Block 5, Irish Life Centre, Abbey Street Lower, Dublin 1, Ireland at 10 am on 18 September 2026, the sole resolution (in relation to a change to the benchmark indices and names of the Funds) was duly passed.

We understand that investors may have questions in relation to this event. If you have any queries, but you do not have a usual iShares contact, you can contact iShares in your respective region on the below contact numbers and email addresses:
·     If located in the United Kingdom or if located elsewhere than the below regions, you can contact iShares at:  info@ishares.co.uk, or the helpline telephone number: +44 207 743 1500
·     If located in Germany, you can contact iShares at: info@iShares.de, or the helpline telephone number: +49 89 42729 5858
·     If located in Switzerland, you can contact iShares at: iSharesSwitzerland@BlackRock.com, or the helpline telephone number 0800 33 66 88
